book_title: 小蓝本高中卷9 不等式的解题与技巧
stem_md: 已知正实数 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 满足 $\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_{i} = 1$, 求证: $$\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sqrt{\frac{1}{x_{i}} - 1} \geqslant (n - 1) \cdot \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{\sqrt{x_{i}} - 1}.$$
original_text_md: 11 已知正实数 $x_{1}, x_{2}, \cdots, x_{n}$ 满足 $\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_{i} = 1$, 求证: $$\sum_{i=1}^{n} \sqrt{\frac{1}{x_{i}} - 1} \geqslant (n - 1) \cdot \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{\sqrt{x_{i}} - 1}.$$
